column1: # bd10 PARTIAL-SUPERBLOCK byte-parity sweep — port vs the in-tree C v4.2.0
# port commit : 71cd6cb35 (+ the bd10 partial-SB post-pass change in the same series)
# host        : aarch64 (Apple), C oracle Bin/Release libSvtAv1Enc.a
#               verdict = `cmp` on the raw OBU streams
# Why the CONTROLS are in the same file: the residual DIFFs are NOT a partial-SB
# gap, and the only way to say that honestly is to hold the other axes fixed.
#   bd8  @ partial   isolates the pre-existing 8-bit partial-SB gap
#   bd10 @ aligned   isolates the pre-existing bd10 NON-FLAT gap
#   bd10 partial p0..p8   490 MATCH / 104 DIFF / 0 ERR   (594 cells)
#   bd10 partial p9..p13  310 MATCH /  20 DIFF / 0 ERR   (330 cells)
#   bd10 aligned p0..p8   241 MATCH /  29 DIFF / 0 ERR   (270 cells)
#   bd8  partial p0..p8   565 MATCH /  29 DIFF / 0 ERR   (594 cells)
#   bd8  aligned p0..p8   270 MATCH /   0 DIFF / 0 ERR   (270 cells)
# bd10-ONLY failures (cell DIFFs at bd10 and MATCHes at bd8), p0..p8:
# Every failing cell on every grid is `gradient`; `uniform` is 100% everywhere.
# BEFORE this series, EVERY bd10 partial row below was a refusal — the encoder
# returned UnsupportedConfig and produced no stream at all.
